rules.statement: In a test project, don't declare a hand-written no-op IDisposable stub (nested or otherwise) for a disposable dependency; use a strict IDisposable mock with a verifiable Dispose setup so the test also proves the scope is disposed.
rules.why: The maintainer replaced a nested NoopDisposable test class with strict IDisposable mocks with verifiable Dispose setups, matching sibling tests. This removes a nested type that breaks the no-nested-types convention and checks that disposal happens.
rules.check: Look in test files for private nested or helper classes that implement IDisposable with an empty Dispose and are only used to satisfy a dependency. Flag them and suggest a strict mock (for example MockRepository.Create<IDisposable>() with a verifiable Dispose setup), as sibling tests already do.
